original_test_intent: Verify all expected FAN1 through FANN outlet-side tachometers are correctly mapped and display BMC readings/status/thresholds that match the sensor specification and current cooling state.
original_method: Enumerate every physical outlet tach channel and immutable raw/UI identity, capture complete RPM/value/unit/status/threshold metadata with synchronized PWM/temperature context, capture WebUI rows and compare each fan to the owner spec with defined scale/rounding/cache semantics.
manual_activity: The owner provides outlet rotor/fan topology, RPM/threshold spec and cooling-context rules; an operator verifies WebUI readability and mapping and adjudicates anomalies.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/firmware and FAN1..N outlet tach channel inventory
Physical fan/rotor/outlet path to SDR/Redfish/UI sensor mapping
Tach unit/scale/thresholds plus zero/not-present and expected RPM-at-PWM semantics
Read-only PWM and relevant temperature/airflow context
UI refresh/rounding tolerance, protected access and evidence/redaction policy
safety_requirements: Keep access read-only; never change fan PWM, thresholds or thermal policy
Use protected authentication and complete non-truncated enumeration
Bind each sample to outlet physical identity and synchronized cooling context
Preserve logs and stop/escalate on zero/implausible tach, alarm, missing/duplicate mapping or cooling fault
Do not substitute inlet tach or refresh until a mismatch disappears
agent_execution_scope: Enumerate/verify full outlet tach population and physical mappings
Assist with synchronized WebUI capture and approved unit/rounding normalization
Report per-fan missing/extra/mismatch/alarm conditions for owner verdict
Perform no cooling mutation or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Supply outlet channel mapping, tach spec and context/tolerance rules
Review raw/UI/context discrepancies and cooling alarms

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool can be a raw source, but a literal FAN1~N name and head-limited fallback do not prove all outlet sensors, physical mapping, thresholds, UI presentation or context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely enumerate complete SDR/Redfish inventory, select every owner-mapped outlet tach record, capture full metadata/context and correlate synchronized WebUI rows to the specification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FAN1~N_TACH_OUTLET scope, WebUI path, reading/threshold/spec comparison and 1/0-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED OUTLET TACH POPULATION VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a per-outlet-rotor matrix containing physical identity, raw RPM/unit/status/threshold, PWM/thermal context and UI display/timestamp, with missing/extra/duplicate and expected-range results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact outlet mapping and operating context while replacing insecure/truncated generic reads and log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One value or screenshot cannot cover FAN1..N or prove outlet association. Every expected outlet channel, threshold and UI/raw mapping is required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Outlet labels may mean a second rotor, airflow side or OEM logical channel. Dynamic fan-control behavior requires project-specific mapping and timing tolerance.

project_override_considerations: If OUTLET refers to the second rotor in a dual-rotor fan, the owner must define its expected relationship to INLET while retaining independent rows and thresholds.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/firmware/fan topology/spec revision
Per-fan outlet channel to raw/UI identity matrix
Synchronized WebUI screenshots and approved rounding/cache comparison
Per-fan differences, no-write/no-log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria coherently target outlet tach readings/thresholds. Outlet semantics and exact fan mapping are project inputs, not contradictory source requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mapping/spec/UI inputs gate execution while static review remains complete.

review_improvement: Defines an outlet-specific complete population and physical/context correlation instead of treating a wildcard-like sensor read as coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Outlet tach evidence must be tied to a physical rotor/channel because identical RPM-like values can come from an inlet channel or adjacent fan. Its plausibility depends on commanded duty and temperature at nearly the same time. UI caching and control-loop movement can explain bounded differences, but only under an approved timing/rounding policy. Missing outlet records cannot be filled with inlet evidence even when both belong to one fan module.
